work.name: Nubia
work.about: Nubia is a conversational agent for quoting and booking TAR flights through WhatsApp.
work.task: I developed the backend in Python, integrated a language model with the booking engine, and structured the solution around hexagonal architecture and event-driven communication.

work.name: Wallet Migration — Ganalottodo
work.about: Redesign of Ganalottodo's wallet system around Blnk to unify balance management.
work.task: I led the system redesign and migration, defined the strategy for transferring data and balances, and developed the backend with Java and Spring.

work.name: Coppel App
work.about: Coppel's Android application, developed with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
work.task: I built analytics modules around the existing data structure and implemented interfaces with Jetpack Compose. I also contributed to publishing application updates.

work.name: TAR México
work.about: TAR México is a flight-booking platform with multiple payment methods and passenger services.
work.task: I implemented and maintained payment and billing features across Java/Spring microservices. On the frontend, I migrated class components to hooks, improved state management, and optimized backend requests and deployment workflows.

work.name: Needed
work.about: Needed is a learning and assessment platform for managing training, courses, and certifications.
work.task: I maintained its frontend and backend, contributed to SSO authentication flows, and worked on the business logic used to calculate assessments.

work.name: Uniken
work.about: Uniken is a digital identity and security platform designed to protect customer interactions.
work.task: I developed private APIs in Python/FastAPI and Java to integrate REST services, databases, S3 buckets, and external providers using dependency injection.
